# BoundingBox { #timetoalign.BoundingBox }

```python
BoundingBox()
```

An axis-aligned box of an image: ``x``, ``y``, ``width``, ``height``.

The members of the Media Fragments and IIIF ``xywh`` region: the
top-left corner and the extent, x right and y down. ``width`` and
``height`` are never negative (zero is kept). All four are on one axis.

Storage struct (derived): ``{x, y, width, height}``, each the number
struct; the axis is the field's (:class:`BoundingBoxField`).

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> box = BoundingBox.from_xywh(385, 46, 139, 20, unit="pixels")
>>> box.x_max
Coordinate(524, pixels)
```

### from_corners { #timetoalign.BoundingBox.from_corners }

```python
BoundingBox.from_corners(ulx, uly, lrx, lry, *, unit=None, number_type=None)
```

The box from its upper-left and lower-right corners.

The corners are points (as MEI's ``ulx`` ... ``lry`` and ATON's
origin plus extent state them): ``width`` is ``lrx - ulx``.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                              |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If a raw number comes without a unit.                                                                                                                    |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the members lie on two axes, a lower-right coordinate lies before its upper-left one, or a value is one the axis cannot hold exactly (never rounded). |

### from_media_fragment { #timetoalign.BoundingBox.from_media_fragment }

```python
BoundingBox.from_media_fragment(text, *, unit, number_type=None)
```

The box a Media Fragments ``xywh`` selector names.

``xywh=x,y,w,h`` and ``xywh=pixel:x,y,w,h`` are read (a leading
``#`` is allowed); ``xywh=percent:`` is refused, since it needs the
image's size.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *text* is no ``xywh`` selector or is a percent one. |

### from_xywh { #timetoalign.BoundingBox.from_xywh }

```python
BoundingBox.from_xywh(x, y, width, height, *, unit=None, number_type=None)
```

The box at ``x``, ``y`` of extent ``width`` by ``height``.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                      | Description                                                                                                 | Default    |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| x           | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                       | The left edge: a raw number, a ``Coordinate`` or an ``IdCoordinate``.                                       | _required_ |
| y           | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                       | The top edge, likewise.                                                                                     | _required_ |
| width       | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                       | The extent along x: a raw number or a ``Duration``.                                                         | _required_ |
| height      | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                       | The extent along y, likewise.                                                                               | _required_ |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None     | The unit of the raw numbers; a scalar carries its own.                                                      | `None`     |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | How the numbers are written; a scalar keeps its own and a raw number takes the unit's default when omitted. | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                   |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If a raw number comes without a unit.                                                                                                         |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the members lie on two axes, an extent is negative, or a value is one the axis cannot hold exactly (``1.5`` on ``pixels``: never rounded). |
